title: ‘Sarabhai Vs Sarabhai’ fame Rajesh Kumar shares his emotional connection with Bihar and Chhath Puja
text:
‘Sarabhai Vs Sarabhai’ fame Rajesh Kumar shares his emotional connection with Bihar and Chhath Puja 
 Home / Entertainment / Bollywood News / Article / Rajesh Kumar recalls celebrating Chhath Puja with his mother in Patna 
 Rajesh Kumar recalls celebrating Chhath Puja with his mother in Patna
 Updated On: 16 November, 2026 11:30 AM IST | Mumbai | IANS 
 Rajesh Kumar opens up about his emotional connection with Bihar and Chhath Puja. He recalls celebrating the festival with his mother in Patna and explains its strict rituals, including a 36-hour fast without water and the emphasis on purity
 Listen to this article : Rajesh Kumar. Pic/Instagram
 ‘Sarabhai Vs Sarabhai’ fame actor Rajesh Kumar has opened up about his deep emotional connection with Bihar and the festival of Chhath Puja.
 As the festival approaches, the actor recalled his childhood celebrations, special moments with his mother and the traditions that continue to hold a special place in his heart. Talking about his earliest memories of the festival, Rajesh recalls how every year has brought something special. However, celebrating Chhath with his mother remains particularly close to his heart.
